d815803af643e47a4e34c232b73c6879.overview: A collection of 24 short four-and-a-half minutes films inspired by still images, including paintings and photographs. An experimental project made by filmmaker Abbas Kiarostami in the last three years of his life.
d815803af643e47a4e34c232b73c6879.tagline: The final film from Abbas Kiarostami

d818813aaebf24b6da58d936245bf3eb.overview: An orphan little girl befriends a benevolent giant who takes her to Giant Country, where they attempt to stop the man-eating giants that are invading the human world.
d818813aaebf24b6da58d936245bf3eb.tagline: The world is more giant than you can imagine.

d81d6701e50f41ddafbcfdc94640fe44.overview: Follow the lives of the Roy family as they contemplate their future once their aging father begins to step back from the media and entertainment conglomerate they control.

d826efb547a47088281cb0957c372282.overview: A married farmer falls under the spell of a slatternly woman from the city, who tries to convince him to drown his wife.
d826efb547a47088281cb0957c372282.tagline: "An artistic masterpiece and also a joy to watch."

d83513f11f807efa5ea3448844bb1439.overview: Wealthy Polly Fulton marries a progressive scholar whose attitudes toward capitalism and acquired wealth puts their marriage in jeopardy.

d89791d58cd544105d624e020ecec0f9.overview: At the start of the First World War, in the middle of Africa’s nowhere, a gin soaked riverboat captain is persuaded by a strong-willed missionary to go down river and face-off a German warship.
d89791d58cd544105d624e020ecec0f9.tagline: The greatest adventure a man ever lived… with a woman!

d8a26018a9441b91b8752417a3291e86.overview: In 1950s London, a renowned dressmaker's meticulous lifestyle begins drastically changing as his relationship with his young muse intensifies.
d8a26018a9441b91b8752417a3291e86.tagline: Whatever you do, do it carefully.

d8a35c953a0958f031a663a482e887b8.overview: After their airplane crashes behind enemy lines, four soldiers must survive and try to find a way back to their battalion. However, when they come across a local peasant girl the horrors of war quickly become apparent.
d8a35c953a0958f031a663a482e887b8.tagline: Trapped… 4 desperate men and a strange half-animal girl!

d8c46bf9bc576bd42d2dd379af211e67.overview: Renowned documentary filmmaker D.A. Pennebaker captures Otis Redding in his ascendancy, singing at the historic Monterey International Pop Festival in June 1967. Comedian Tom Smothers introduces Redding to a crowd that is leaving -- until Redding grabs them with his charged rendition of "Shake." Redding's performance also includes "Respect" (which he wrote), "I've Been Loving You Too Long," "Satisfaction," and "Try a Little Tenderness." Tragically, Redding died in a plane crash six months later. An innovative filmmaker who started in the 1950s making experimental films, Pennebaker garnered an Oscar nomination for Best Documentary Feature in 1993 for The War Room, his behind-the-scenes look at Bill Clinton's 1992 campaign. His other subjects have included Norman Mailer, Bob Dylan, and David Bowie.

d8e78e27137a8fe133b7a3991ea91d7f.overview: Alex, an ex-con working as muscle in a Vienna brothel, dreams of escaping with his girlfriend Tamara, who also works there. Their attempt to break free sets off a chain of events that links their fate with a rural police officer and his troubled marriage. As their lives intersect, a quiet struggle unfolds between guilt, grief, and the desire for redemption.
d8e78e27137a8fe133b7a3991ea91d7f.tagline: Whose fault is it if life doesn't go your way?

d8ed7b53c906a2e431ef474b0f3c8641.overview: London bookstore owner William Thacker's quiet life turns upside down when a chance encounter with famous actress Anna Scott sparks an unlikely romance challenged by their vastly different worlds.
d8ed7b53c906a2e431ef474b0f3c8641.tagline: Can the most famous film star in the world fall for the man on the street?
